text: When a client hasn't paid in the past, we ask for a deposit before each visit. Marking the client tells everyone who books.
Mark the client once, with a reason. It's here on the client page, under the client alerts.
Scout asks why, so the team knows.
Now it's on the client, with the reason and your name, and it says how to collect the deposit.
When the client is back in good standing, click Clear to take it off.
On the schedule, anyone who opens one of his visits
sees Deposit required at the top of the client alerts, with what to do.
Managers, billing and lead client liaisons can mark or clear it. Everyone else sees it, but can't change it.
The most common mistake is marking a client without a reason, so nobody knows when to clear it. Remember: mark the client once, with a reason, and every booking reminds the team to collect a deposit.
